dog.description_text: Sweet Khaleesi is a loving girl who may need a little time to feel comfortable in new surroundings. She has been fearful while in care, but she is slowly warming up with a calm, patient, and gentle approach. Once she feels safe, her sweet personality begins to shine through. Khaleesi enjoys relaxing with her blanket and pillow, loves car rides, and is happiest when she can take things at her own pace. She is crate trained, walks nicely on leash, and knows cues such as "sit," "snack," and "stay." She would do best with someone who understands that trust takes time and is willing to give her the patience and space she needs to build confidence. With a slow approach and a little TLC, Khalessi has the potential to blossom into a wonderful companion.
dog.name: Khaleesi
